name: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic)
description: The Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnostic (WDBC) dataset contains 569 instances with 30 continuous real-valued features computed from digitized fine needle aspirate (FNA) images of breast masses. Features describe characteristics of cell nuclei (radius, texture, perimeter, area, smoothness, compactness, concavity, symmetry) to classify masses as benign or malignant.
